narrative.overview:
A friend takes a black marker to a sheet of graph paper, tapes the real kit photo to it, and draws arrows to the soil, the seeds, the sprayer and the tools. Every section is an explained drawing, not a sales block: headings are hand-lettered, boxes are ruled by hand with a second offset stroke, lists sit on lined paper, sticky notes are taped down, and a small sprout-in-a-box mascot, Brotinho, acts out each step. The page is warm and plainly instructive, the register of a notebook page someone made for you.

Density is relaxed: one idea per panel, generous section rhythm, and the graph grid always visible so the paper reads as a surface. Real photography carries the product truth; drawing carries the explanation. Nothing is glossy, blurred or gradient-lit. The marker world refuses the eco-D2C template of stock leaves, badge rows and equal icon cards.

Motion is the act of drawing: arrows, ticks, stars, swipes and highlighter bands draw themselves in when their section enters view. Text is never hidden, and under reduced motion or without JavaScript everything is already drawn.
keyCharacteristics: Off-white paper with a faint forest-green 28px graph grid across the whole page.
Black marker ink for every border, arrow and outline; Kalam lettering for everything drawn, Archivo for prose.
Hand-ruled boxes with asymmetric wobble radii and a second, offset ink stroke.
Sprout green as the single action fill; beet magenta only as a second highlighter and marker accent.
Annotated real photography: taped photos with drawn arrows or numbered pins.
Brotinho the mascot as line art in numbered comic panels.
Draw-on reveal with exponential ease-out; already drawn when motion is reduced.

rules.name: The One Fill Rule
rules.body: Sprout is the only color a button is filled with, and every sprout-filled button opens WhatsApp. No second button color exists.

rules.name: The Two Markers Rule
rules.body: There are exactly two highlighters: sprout for the primary swipe and beet (28% mix) for secondary emphasis. A third highlighter color is never introduced.

rules.name: The Forest Text Rule
rules.body: Green type is always forest (#1c7434), never sprout; sprout is a fill and a highlighter, not a text color on paper.

rules.name: The Marker Speaks, Archivo Explains Rule
rules.body: Anything that reads as drawn or handwritten is Kalam; any sentence of explanation is Archivo. Archivo never appears as a heading.

rules.name: The Kalam Band Rule
rules.body: The highlighter band sits at 46% to 90% of the line box in Archivo and moves up to 40% to 74% in Kalam, whose tall font box would otherwise push the band below the letters.

rules.name: The Graph Paper Rule
rules.body: The grid runs under every section by default; surfaces sit on it rather than covering the page.

rules.name: The Quiet Band Rule
rules.body: One deliberately calmer band separates the densest content: the Nossos Kits section drops the grid behind a white wash at 70% opacity, bordered top and bottom by 2.5px ink rules. The footer reuses the same wash with a top rule. Use the band for a dense product section, not as a general section background.

rules.name: The Second Stroke Rule
rules.body: Lift is a second offset outline in ink, never a blurred shadow. Only paper and tape cast a real (tiny) shadow.

rules.name: The Wobble Rule
rules.body: Every bordered drawn box uses an asymmetric wobble radius and a slight tilt; only photographs and the floating button are geometrically clean.

dos: **Do** set every border, arrow and doodle in marker ink (#1a1a1a) at 2 to 3px.
**Do** give drawn boxes an asymmetric wobble radius, a second offset stroke and a 1 to 2 degree tilt.
**Do** keep the 28px forest graph grid visible under every section except the one quiet band.
**Do** annotate real photography with drawn arrows or numbered pins; tape photos down.
**Do** use Kalam for anything drawn or handwritten and Archivo for explanation.
**Do** make every WhatsApp action the sprout action button with deep-leaf-ink label.
**Do** render everything fully drawn when motion is reduced or JavaScript is off.
donts: **Don't** lift cards with blurred drop shadows; depth is the second stroke.
**Don't** fill a button with any color but sprout, or fill a box, band or note with full-strength sprout; non-action surfaces use the sprout wash.
**Don't** set green text in sprout; green type is forest.
**Don't** add a third highlighter color or more than one sprout swipe per heading.
**Don't** use perfectly square or uniformly rounded borders on drawn boxes.
**Don't** use emoji or icon-font glyphs; marks are drawn SVG strokes, and the WhatsApp mark is the brand asset.
**Don't** hide or fade text as part of the reveal; only strokes and highlighter bands animate.
